% Testaments: a full-page-width divider, TOC section level.
\newcommand{\xchapter}[1]{%
  \clearpage\phantomsection\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{#1}%
  \vspace*{2em}\begin{center}%
  {\normalfont\fontsize{20}{24}\selectfont\bfseries\color{heading}#1\par}%
  \end{center}%
  \vspace{1pt}{\color{accent}\hrule height 1.2pt}\vspace{2em}}

% Books: new page, TOC subsection level.
\newcommand{\xsection}[1]{%
  \clearpage\phantomsection\addcontentsline{toc}{subsection}{#1}%
  {\normalfont\fontsize{16}{20}\selectfont\bfseries\color{heading}%
   \raggedright #1\par}%
  \vspace{2pt}{\color{accent}\hrule height 0.8pt}\medskip}

% Chapters: a bold heading, not in the TOC.
\newcommand{\xsubsection}[1]{%
  \needspace{3\baselineskip}\par\medskip
  {\normalfont\fontsize{12.5}{15.5}\selectfont\bfseries\color{subhead}%
   \raggedright #1\par}%
  \nobreak\smallskip}

% Argument: the italic summary standing at the head of a book or chapter.
\newcommand{\drarg}[1]{\par\smallskip{\itshape\color{subhead}#1\par}\smallskip}

% Note: Challoner's explanatory commentary, set small and indented.
\newcommand{\drnote}[1]{\par{\small\itshape\leftskip=1.5em\color{subhead}#1\par}}
